1.title: Gavin Newsom and His Wife Made $1.4 Million in 2024, Tax Returns Show
1.summary: The taxable income of California’s governor and his wife, Jennifer Siebel Newsom, exceeded $1 million a year from 2021 to 2024.

2.title: Ukraine’s Strike on Iranian Ship Shows How Two Wars Could Spiral
2.summary: Iran sent military aid to Russia for its war against Ukraine. Now the question is whether that conflict and the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran are converging.

3.title: A Fledgling Food Reviewer’s Battle With Cyclospora
3.summary: Christina Hart, 29, started posting reviews on social media in May. Less than two months later, a stomach illness forced her to stop.

4.title: Spain's PM blames traffickers after 60,000 migrants reach Ceuta from Morocco
4.summary: Spain's prime minister described the situation as an "attack" on its North African territory and said all illegal migrants would be returned to Morocco.

5.title: Live Updates: Most of the Migrants Who Crossed Into Spanish Territory Have Returned, Officials Say
5.summary: About 37,000 of the up to 60,000 people who came into Ceuta from Morocco returned within a day. Still, the sudden influx created a crisis for Spain’s pro-immigration government. At least 34 people died.

6.title: Trump’s Gaza Deal Sparks Questions on Whether Israel, Hamas Will Comply
6.summary: The new 15-point plan, released by the Board of Peace and announced by Trump, calls in part for Israel to end its attacks and Hamas to give up its weapons.
